name: Aurora
usage: optional OpenSPM Stage-A native GX renderer foundation
notes: Use upstream encounter/aurora directly; do not copy WiiCompiled GPL runtime code.
OpenSPM must supply original-console guest-memory translation and display-list handling.
Upstream Aurora does not currently implement GXClearBoundingBox/GXReadBoundingBox.
Upstream Aurora raw display-copy handling is not sufficient as OpenSPM's frame presentation contract.
